reviews.title: Regret Not Booking a Ferry
reviews.text: We paid and extra $100 in baggage fees because the carry on limit was 8kg… we were better off taking a ferry which was longer but A LOT cheaper. Don’t book with them please. Wish I could have canceled the flight last minute

reviews.title: Terrible service!!!!
reviews.text: This airline is terrible!!! They cancelled the flight and just refunded the minimum. They don’t reply back to my emails even after 6 months!!! They go against the law by not refunding properly their customers. I should never have booked them. Real mistake

reviews.title: Bumpy ride and plane is very old

reviews.title: Horrible airline
reviews.text: The gate was still open and people were boarding the plane but they wouldn’t let us check in. There wasn’t a single person at the desk to help people. No one did anything about it to help us out as we were delayed from a previous flight. A lady came to “help” us but did nothing and continued to say that she had left the check in desk so there was nothing she could do. Useless and unhelpful.
reviews.author: Jacqui S

reviews.title: Despite bad reviews , our flights turned out okay
reviews.text: Flying from manila terminal 4 to Basuanga ,Coron. Seat is comfortable and spacious. 10kg check in baggage. Please pack carefully. Onboard baggage size has to be very small due to the height of the overhead cabin spaces.
reviews.author: TrailsOfAnne

reviews.title: Performed okay
reviews.text: Boarding started an hour late and the flight left 25 min late then arrived 40 min late. This was okay overall.
reviews.author: Brendan

reviews.title: A rowboat would be a more reliable form of transportation...
reviews.text: Flights are consistently delayed with no concern for customers. Our original flight from Manila to Coron was delayed 2 hours so when we asked for an earlier return flight to ensure we made out connection in Manila, we were told we need to pay a 4000 peso fee. When we asked if we could be refunded the fee due to the airline's incompetence, we were told that our flight was on time and there was nothing they could do. Skyjet is barely a company and it seems they make a majority of their money from screwing over it's customers. If I could give them 0 stars, I would gladly do it. AVOID!!!!
reviews.author: Connor C

reviews.title: If I could give ZERO rating, I would!
reviews.text: Skyjet has cancelled our flight due to bad weather. I was so puzzled as the other airlines arrived on time and everything went so smoothly. It was a nice sunny day, what a disappointment for them to cancel their fligt! But its their call so go on, we have rebooked our flight with another airline and fly on the same they when Skyjet cancelled their flight. Now, here we go, THE REFUND. Its been over a month now and still no refund. I have contacted them multiple times and always "PROCESSING". This is a complete joke, processing for a month for a refund?? and still waiting for the confirmation. You're the most unreliable airline and the worst customer service ever. We will never fly with you again!
reviews.author: Liezl

reviews.title: Cheap airline
reviews.text: Our flight was one of the many which was affected by the Taal volcanic eruption. The volcano erupted on the 12th of January, and our flight was on the 13th. We kept an eye on the news all night to see whether our flight will be cancelled. Our flight was at 10.30am, but from 3am we have been ringing the airline to see if they have any update on whether this will be cancelled. Their office in Manila could not be reached. I tried contacting them on facebook because they seem to be posting promotional adverts even at early hours of the morning. But just like the landline, no one was available to answer. We tried ringing the airport terminal, and we were told that all flights up to 11am will be cancelled, so we stayed at home for further update. We managed to get hold of someone from Skyjet at 8.15am. When I asked why was there no one answering their phone, the man I spoke with has said their office dont open until 8am. Bearing in mind that there was a natural disaster which could potentially affect the flights, they did not think of assigning someone to assist their worried passengers. Fortunately, we managed to get to the airport on time. To be fair, once we got to the airport, the airline personnels were very accommodating and friendly. It was a shame because their customer service was really good up until the disaster happened. Perhaps they should consider assigning someone to assist passenger in times like these. It is a shame because their service is actually very good
reviews.author: vida turingan

reviews.title: A bit of a greedy company
reviews.text: I organised a trip to the Philippines with my family this January. Part of the trip we booked a flight with Skyjet (3 passengers) A few days before the beginning of our trip there was the Taal vulcano explosion. The explosion was nowhere near Coron but all the trip had to be cancelled as news suggested things would get worst. So we decided to start cancelling our flights and hotels and look for alternatives. I contacted Skyjet. After the second email they contacted me informing that of the total amount I payed: PHP 18,744.72 they would refund me only: PHP 2,844.72. There is no way I can’t find here some sort level of greediness. The reputation of an airline is all about the way you respect and take care of your passengers and I will stay away from them in the future. KR I J Bastos
reviews.author: Jose Bastos

reviews.title: Chill!
reviews.text: Reading these scathing reviews before our flight, I was pretty put off! But went for it regardless as SkyJet offered the best timing for our trip. It was genuinely fine. Yes it was slightly delayed (less than an hour), and yes we had to pay 360 PHP per kg above the luggage limit (fine. That’s our fault for overpacking); but it was all good. I’d definitely fly with SkyJet again. FYI, You can purchase 20kg when you buy the flights. 800 PHP each. Job done.

reviews.title: Flight on 10 passenger plane.
reviews.text: Small hopper plane. Long walk for tarmac boarding. No wheelchair assistance. only bisquiict and water served.

reviews.text: These company are completely scam and after your refund.Incase you have to cancel with in 5 minute .

reviews.author: Lobsang S

reviews.title: Awful refund policy
reviews.text: Booked a flight from Coron to Manila on the website 2 pax with purchase of additional luggage allowance. Went to Cebuana shop to make a cash payment of 13,000 pesos, 1 day later our plans changed and no longer going to Coron island so emailed to cancel the flights. Was told that after all the charges and cancellation fees we would be getting 3,300 pesos back from our cash payment of 13,000 and on top of that it is not going to be paid out until 60 BANKING days (equivalents of 3 months) and will have to be collected from there airline office and payment is only by cheque. Now I understand I am the one canceling but after just 24 hours and 5 days until the flight this is just terrible. I have learnt the hard way, my message is if you book with them be certain you can fly on your dates as when you tour Palawan plans can and do change.
reviews.author: Gordon W

reviews.title: For a 9.8K PHP ticket ended up paying 15K PHP
reviews.text: If for any reason you card fails during online payment you are forced to do the entire process from the beginning.. and the tickets have gone up by a few hundred pesos. You are allowed to purchase extra luggage like I did but no more than 10kg (cost 800 PHP). You cannot purchase more. You are not notified of the airport cost for extra KG. At the airport you pay 360 PHP for each extra kilo. It is s rippoff. Nobody cares and you are blackmailed in paying thousands more. Scammers I DO NOT recommend this airline.
reviews.author: Fotis Routsis

reviews.title: SCAMMERS! Avoid!
reviews.text: These people are crooks, and will make you suffer until you are so desperate you will pay them. We arrived at the check in gate 1hr before our flight (there website states you need to be at the check in 45 minutes before). We were told we could not check in as the check in was closed. We couldn’t believe this - can they tell the time? Naturally, we kicked up a huge fuss. We THEN got told they had actually sold our seats to other people, and the flight was full. Excuse me?! We had booked the tickets months in advance. We had 2 international connecting flights to catch. We even demanded to watch (and we recorded) the CCTV footage of us arriving at check in on time, as they tried to argue that we were late. They knew they were wrong. They were even arguing about it between themselves. We were essentially begging them to do the right thing and get us our seats back (our seats, the ones we booked and paid for months ago). They then offered us another flight 3 hours later (we completely missed our connecting flights). After much complaining and deliberating, we knew we weren’t getting anywhere, so we said fine. They assured we would be priority on this flight and get us on straight away. Then it came to check in for THAT flight, and they said no we were actually on a waiting list, and would only get on if people did not show. We literally could not believe it, another 30 minutes of arguing. Luckily there were a few no shows, so we were ready to check in. THEY THEN SAID WE HAD TO PA
reviews.author: Jas

reviews.title: Avoid if at all possible!
reviews.text: Avoid these scam artists at all costs! They state they allow 1 checked bag per passenger with a weight limit of 10kg (about 20lbs) per bag. We each had 1 bag that was 10kg, but we also had a 3rd bag to check. I figured it would be an extra $25 or so to check it, but they charged $150 for it! I have since read they do this to non filipinos, so there may be discrimination involved (i.e. "skin tax). $150 was more than the bag and all its contents was worth, but once you are there, what can you do? On another note, they wait until 90 mins before departure before even showing up at the check in counter, so if you get to the airport early as you should, you will be waiting a while. They also apparently don't clean the plane between flights, as on our 45 min flight back to Manila, my wife and I both caught a nasty cold - and I very rarely get sick, so it must have been someone on the previous flight that left our seats covered in germs. On the plus side we got where we were going, which is the only reason I didn't give it 1 star. Conclusion: Do yourself a favor, fly with another airline so you don't get scammed for luggage fees and lessen your chance of being sick for half of your hard earned vacation.
reviews.author: husker3in4

reviews.title: DO NOT use Skyjet. They are terrible
reviews.text: We arrive at the airport and told the crew is late. So far, we have been delayed for over two hours for a 45 minute flight. They will not provide any updates. The weather is sunny and no rain delay. Now, they are saying maybe another crew will arrive. They refuse to book us on another carrier. Horrible and it’s ruining our leisure time. Recommend to go to another island because Sky Jet sucks.
reviews.author: Shawn W

reviews.title: Cheap and for those with no choice
reviews.text: Cabin crew looked lax and unaccommodating. Seats were worn and ride was bumpy the whole way, understandable during the weather. Mediocre, will only ride again if price of tickets are good.
reviews.author: Andrew John y Fernandes

reviews.title: Discrimination
reviews.text: The check in clerk most obviously hates non Filipinos. I had carefully checked the baggage restrictions and sizes. She refused my carry on as to big. I pointed out the sixes as per the printed ticket, I asked to see the size cage, she refused and said I cannot board unless I check my carry on bag in the hold. I reluctantly agreed, she then said an extra hold bag is extra and I was over weight on my check in luggage. I was completely with weight and size according to there own website. I had no choice but to pay. $200. Twice the cost of the ticket. But wait Filipinos were loading bags on, no charge, carry on twice my bag size, no charge. But then just to add insult to injury the 146 seater plane only had 26 passengers, 25 Filipinos and me, more than enough room for my carry on. Blatant racism and discrimination
reviews.author: Philip S

reviews.title: Batanes vacay
reviews.text: It's a smooth flight to/from Batanes. Nice plane and comfortable seats. Flight attendants are very attentive to the needs of passengers. Though ticket fare may be expensive, we just need to check out on promos thats within your budget.
reviews.author: joy

reviews.title: TO BE AVOIDED
reviews.text: Worst experience ever. Flights got cancelled twice due to a slight rain ( while Cebu and Philipppine airlines were flying)and we had to postpone with a surcharge our outbound flight from Manila to Europe because we have to stay one more night in coron.(of which 12 hrs in that warehouse called busu anca airport).We were told that their planes are bigger but older and not equipped properly to withstand landing with light rain. From what i’ve Seen also other airlines like air swift are not equipped. Customer service?!? Totally missing.
reviews.author: Laura

reviews.title: Update re Refund!!!
reviews.text: We got our REFUND like last month! Thanks Skyjet! Though my brother and I did not expect it at all (we have up already) since it feels like forever waiting, we still appreciate it. I think if you have lots of time, just keep on calling them. But still not to expect too much. Expectation realy hurts. Again thanks Skyjet!
reviews.author: Anna Angela

reviews.title: DON’T FLY SKYJET
reviews.text: This is a WTF Moment. I thought skyjet airlines was decent, until the end of my vacation. We were supposed to fly from Coron to Manila and then stay for 2 nights at Manila and fly back to the states. It was a nightmare. We were stuck at the pre-departure gate at USU (Coron airport) waiting for our flight. It said that the aircraft will come in 15 minutes, or what I thought it would be. 15 minutes came to 30, 30 to an hour, and then it said that our flight had been canceled, JUST BECAUSE OF A LITTLE RAIN. We ended up having to talk to the agent over and they said they had nothing to do. We ended up being at standby for quite some time. Waiting for the next 2 skyjet flights, skyjet was like, nah fam. Both flights canceled, and we ended up staying the night at Coron. Next day, we were at the airport again. The next skyjet flight was at 1pm while at standby. We ended up having to book through Philippine airlines. Supposing we had booked it the day of the skyjet cancelations before. We ended up being on standby for both Skyjet and Philippine airlines. Skyjet has a few standby passengers on the flight. We ended up not being in the skyjet flight because it was full. But, THANK YOU PHILIPPINE AIRLINES. We got the PAL flight to Clark (Neighboring city near Manila) the people at the Philippine airlines counter helped us out to get on that flight. So Thanks PAL. Never fly Skyjet.
reviews.author: Nico Ylarde
